claims.claim: Tap and untap are card orientations; tapping rotates a card 90 degrees from its upright position.
A card's orientation cannot be changed arbitrarily; a card in the mana zone may be tapped without a card-type eligibility check.
A card already tapped cannot be made tapped again; selecting or attempting to tap it is distinct from a completed tap state change.

scopeLimit: Design only: one already-selected card in the acting player's mana zone; no untap, battle-zone eligibility, mana payment, replacement, or trigger processing.
